scope: The Ezekiel R. Dumke Jr. main gallery of the Fort Douglas Military Museum at 1990 East Potter Street, an 1870s sandstone enlisted barrack, pictured in May 2022.

references.filename: Fort Douglas Military Museum - Salt Lake City, Utah - 15 May 2022.jpg

originalReview.notes: The museum sign identifies the near main gallery. The image shows its tan-red sandstone, deeply shaded full porch, thin white posts and braces, X-pattern railing and dark gable roof.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla’s exact May 2022 bytes match the Commons upload and its native photographer’s CC0 dedication. Other subjects shown in the story’s corpus are independent portions of the larger garrison.
